basic_profile.bio: A maritime enthusiast who enjoys discussing naval operations and civilian space ventures. Based in Idaho Falls, I work as a consultant for a logistics company, focusing on supply chain management. In my free time, I like exploring the local nature and am a fan of reality TV shows like Below Deck. I typically surf Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm single and enjoy engaging in online communities to share my passions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Maritime Studies and have worked in various roles within the shipping and logistics industry. My interest in space technologies led me to self-study topics related to aerospace, which I often discuss in relevant subreddits.
